import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 208

aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="storage_write", target="repro_gen5.py", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="Gen 5 Repro (Corrected)", metadata={"eval_id": 503, "status": "failed", "reason": "JSONDecodeError"})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="log_actions", target="log_actions", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not recognized"})
